title: Finite type flat module has a finitely presented stalk
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a finitely presented homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], let $N$ be a finite $B$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and let $\mathfrak q$ be a prime of $B$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. If the localization $N_{\mathfrak q}$ is flat as an $A$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then $N_{\mathfrak q}$ is a finitely presented $B_{\mathfrak q}$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module].

proof.text:
Put (X=operatorname{Spec}(B)), (S=operatorname{Spec}(A)), let
(f:X	o S) be induced by (A	o B), let
(mathcal F=\widetilde N), and let (x) be the point (mathfrak q), with
(s=f(x)) corresponding to (mathfrak p=mathfrak qcap A).  The finite
presentation of (B) over (A) makes (f) locally of finite presentation,
and finiteness of (N) makes (mathcal F) of finite type.  Moreover
(mathcal F_x=N_{mathfrak q}) and (mathcal O_{S,s}=A_{mathfrak p});
the assumed (A)-flatness localizes to (A_{mathfrak p})-flatness.  Apply
the etale-neighborhood proposition (Tag 05I6) to obtain an etale
neighborhood ((S',s')\to(S,s)) and an open (V) around the induced point
(x') in (X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}(mathcal O_{S',s'})) on which the
pulled-back module is finitely presented and flat over
(mathcal O_{S',s'}).

source.place: Tag 05I7 proof, first sentence: apply Proposition 05I6.

proof.text: The local-ring map $\mathcal O_{X,x}\to\mathcal O_{X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}(\mathcal O_{S',s'}),x'}$ is flat and local: the etale map is flat by the definition of etale morphism, and passage to the indicated local rings is a localization, hence flat by Tag 00HT. Therefore it is faithfully flat by the flat-local-faithfully-flat lemma. By the definition of stalk and affine pullback, the stalk of the pulled-back sheaf at $x'$ identifies with $\mathcal F_x\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}\mathcal O_{X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}(\mathcal O_{S',s'}),x'}$, and this module is finitely presented over the latter local ring by Step 1.

source.place: Tag 05I7 proof, paragraph beginning 'The ring map O_{X,x} → O_{X ×_S Spec(O_{S',s'}),x'} is flat and local'.

proof.text: Apply faithful-flat descent of finite presentation for modules (Tag 03C4(2)) to the map in Step 2 and the module $\mathcal F_x$. Since its tensor product with the faithfully flat target is the finitely presented stalk from Step 2, $\mathcal F_x$ is finitely presented over $\mathcal O_{X,x}$, which is the asserted conclusion.

source.place: Tag 05I7 proof, final sentence, citing Algebra Lemma 03C4 (lemma-descend-properties-modules), part (2).
